title: 57:6 stones. These may have been stones that were set up for a male fertility deity (Jer. 32:35). Or perhaps these stones refer to the smooth stones from a stream that David used to slay Goliath (1 Sam. 17:40-50). The people here were choosing the smooth stones of the stream instead of the Rock who is their Redeemer (Ps. 78:35; Moses 7:53).
author: Tina M. Peterson
